source_document: Growatt MAX 100-125KTL3-X LV Installation & Operation Manual, Section 7 (Troubleshooting & Error Codes)

ERROR_102.title: Isolation Fault (ISO-F)
ERROR_102.description: Ground isolation resistance of the PV array is below the safe operational threshold.
ERROR_102.oem_definition: PV Isolation Low (Error 102). Inverter detected PV array impedance to earth ground is below the permissible safety threshold.
potential_causes: Damaged DC cable jacket or rodent chewing
Moisture in string junction box or MC4 connectors
Inadequate array bonding or ground fault
ERROR_102.recommended_action: Perform string insulation resistance testing per Growatt service manual. Inspect DC cable runs and replace faulty connectors.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Switch off AC breaker and DC isolators. Follow electrical lockout/tagout protocol.
Inspect DC cabling along cable trays and conduit entries for physical abrasions or water intrusion.
Disconnect individual strings and use a 1000V insulation resistance tester to pinpoint the grounded string.
Replace damaged section/connector, re-measure insulation (>1M ohm), and restore inverter power.

ERROR_106.title: Grid Overvoltage
ERROR_106.description: Grid AC voltage exceeded the upper operating threshold configured on the inverter.
ERROR_106.oem_definition: AC Voltage Out of Range (Error 106). Inverter disconnected from the grid because utility line voltage exceeds grid compliance window.
potential_causes: Grid supply overvoltage from local utility substation
High impedance on AC feeder cable during peak solar feed-in
Incorrect inverter grid standard parameter settings
ERROR_106.recommended_action: Monitor utility grid voltage. If persistent, check AC cable gauge and transformer tap settings.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure AC line-to-line and line-to-neutral voltages at the inverter AC terminals.
Verify inverter automatically reconnects when utility voltage returns within nominal limits.

ERROR_108.title: Inverter Overtemperature
ERROR_108.description: Inverter internal heatsink or ambient temperature exceeded thermal safety cutoff limits.
ERROR_108.oem_definition: Inverter Over Temperature (Error 108). Internal thermal sensors tripped thermal protection derating or shutdown.
potential_causes: Cooling fan blockage, failure, or dust accumulation
Direct solar exposure on inverter chassis without sunshade
Insufficient ventilation clearance around heatsink fins
ERROR_108.recommended_action: Inspect external cooling fans, clean heatsink fins with compressed air, and ensure ventilation clearance.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Allow inverter heatsink to cool down before servicing.
Inspect external fans for foreign debris, dust build-up, or mechanical binding.
Verify fan supply voltage and test fan rotation in maintenance mode.
Power on inverter and verify temperature stabilization below 65°C under high load.

ERROR_101.title: Grid Frequency Deviation
ERROR_101.description: Grid AC frequency deviated outside acceptable operational boundaries (47.5 Hz - 52.0 Hz).
ERROR_101.oem_definition: Grid Frequency Out of Range (Error 101). Inverter tripped due to utility frequency instability.
potential_causes: Utility grid disturbance or load-shedding transient
Diesel generator synchronization failure during islanding
ERROR_101.recommended_action: Log frequency event and monitor grid stability.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure grid frequency with calibrated power quality analyzer.

ERROR_103.title: Residual Current Trip (GFCI)
ERROR_103.description: Inverter ground fault current interrupter detected residual leakage current > 300mA.
ERROR_103.oem_definition: Residual Current Fault (Error 103). Excessive DC/AC leakage current to ground.
potential_causes: High parasitic capacitance to ground during morning dew
ERROR_103.recommended_action: Check grounding conductor and test leakage current across strings.

general_field_guidance.instruction: Measure DC leakage current with AC/DC clamp meter.
